Info

Defines structural protocol ICanvasWaypointBuilder for interactive waypoint instantiation.

class scarajectory.infrastructure.gui.canvas.handler.icanvas_waypoint_builder.ICanvasWaypointBuilder(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Protocol

Structural protocol for constructing and relocating waypoints on canvas.

It defines:

methods:
create_waypoint_at - Builds a new Waypoint at world coordinates.
create_relocated_waypoint - Builds updated Waypoint retaining existing properties.
_abc_impl = <_abc._abc_data object>¶
_is_protocol = True¶
_is_runtime_protocol = True¶
create_relocated_waypoint(current: Waypoint, wx: float, wy: float) → Waypoint[source]¶

Builds updated Waypoint with relocated coordinates and preserved properties.

Parameters:

  • current – Current Waypoint instance.

  • wx – New world X coordinate.

  • wy – New world Y coordinate.

Returns:

Updated Waypoint object.

Exceptions:

None.

create_waypoint_at(wx: float, wy: float, settings: CanvasSettings) → Waypoint[source]¶

Builds a new Waypoint at given world coordinates.

Parameters:

  • wx – World X coordinate.

  • wy – World Y coordinate.

  • settings – Active CanvasSettings.

Returns:

Instantiated Waypoint object.

Exceptions:

None.
